name: 32B Q4 LLM on a standard smartphone

mentions.name: 32B Q4 LLM on a standard smartphone
mentions.description: This project runs a 32B-parameter quantized (Q4) large language model on a standard smartphone, streaming MoE weights from SSD/UFS storage and tiering memory across RAM/UFS/microSD on Android without root access.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm trying to run a 32B Q4 model on a standard smartphone. It's a pretty interesting project.
mentions.author: nolon
